_comment: Single shared profile since 2026-10-20 — every Discord member is on it. The ID stays P05 because the ledger, entries & exits, thesis summaries and the monthly pattern study are all keyed to it; only the display names changed (was 'Aggressive Growth' / #signals-aggressive). The ten-profile file is archived at profiles/_archive/profiles-10-profiles-20261020.json. investment_horizon_months and long_term_ideas_allowed are kept from the original build on purpose: the signals are traded as short-term momentum, and that framing lives in the Shared investment signals scheduled task, not here. 'discord_role' is the Discord role name; 'discord_channel' is the signals channel name.

profiles.name: Signals
profiles.description: Momentum signals from the US and European screeners. Every recommendation is tracked from the price it fired at, and the Entries & exits tab holds the actionable trades.
